audit_name: Standardized Inference Latency & Boundary Reconciliation Audit

discrepancy_investigation.audit_finding: TIMING_BOUNDARY_MISMATCH. The 0.0041 ms figure was measured exclusively on the classifier inference step (predict_proba) executing matrix-vector multiplication in C/BLAS on pre-transformed sparse feature matrices already loaded in RAM. It omitted all raw text preprocessing, structural parsing, dictionary-based skill extraction, and TF-IDF vectorization. Comparing this 0.004 ms classifier-only time with end-to-end neural cross-encoder latency (15.4 ms) was an invalid comparison.
discrepancy_investigation.scientific_correction: Inference latency must be benchmarked with explicit stage boundaries: End-to-End Latency (Raw Text -> Prediction) versus Classifier-Only Latency.

sla_compliance_verdict: Production end-to-end latency (16.57 ms mean) is suitable for interactive web API serving (< 50 ms SLA target). Pre-computing features for recurring jobs/resumes reduces inference time to 0.24 ms.
